# The Agentic Future: Are federal agencies prepared for what’s ahead?


A new report from ICF reveals that the next phase of AI adoption won't be defined by technology alone.


Get the report


The Agentic Future: Are federal agencies prepared for what’s ahead?


Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is gaining traction across federal agencies, but federal leaders find that scaling it is an operational challenge more than a technical one.


The latest research from MeriTalk and ICF reveals:


### 45%


say their agencies are using agentic AI in at least one production or operational workflow.


### 34%


say their agency is exploring or piloting agentic AI.


### 85%


expect agentic AI to become critical to their mission within the next three years.


### 91%


say the biggest challenge with agentic AI will be redesigning workflows, not deploying the technology.


## AI readiness gaps


While most federal leaders feel prepared for key elements of agentic AI, far fewer have taken critical foundational actions.
